scenario: READ_ONLY_RUN route planner proposal; no candidate execution

input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin containing one component validation plan, one workflow run/jobs snapshot, one artifact inventory with extracted basenames and completeness flag, and an optional component validation receipt.
required_outputs: Deterministic JSON receipt with plan/run/artifact identity bindings, selected-target IDs, receipt presence or binding status, observed job intervals, source/tool digests, and explicit non-claims.

unmet_outputs: Deterministic JSON receipt with plan/run/artifact identity bindings, selected-target IDs, receipt presence or binding status, observed job intervals, source/tool digests, and explicit non-claims.

covered_outputs: Deterministic JSON receipt with plan/run/artifact identity bindings, selected-target IDs, receipt presence or binding status, observed job intervals, source/tool digests, and explicit non-claims.

findings: Default route excludes the candidate and is incomplete for the requested plan/run/artifact attribution outputs.
Explicit allowlisting selects exactly this candidate and completes the declared output coverage, while execution_authorized remains false.
The selected candidate remains READ_ONLY_RUN with empty write paths and network, secrets, billing, and external actions all false.
claim_ceiling: A route-planner proposal only. It does not invoke the candidate, authenticate inputs, change permissions, certify validation, or authorize merge/release.
